programme.title: Hostile Planet
programme.desc: There are places with extremely difficult conditions.Living there requires a constant fight for survival, adapting to fierce frosts, heat, storms, snowstorms and heavy rainfall.Access to these areas is often difficult.The situation is worsened by climate change and rare weather events that have impacted many species.The extraordinary cinematography by Guillermo Navarro, who won an Oscar for "Pan's Labyrinth", will better show this intriguing world where danger lurks at every step.

programme.title: America's Wild Spaces
programme.desc: A story about the untamed forces of nature, danger and natural wonders that can be discovered in the wildest regions of America.Viewers, together with the creators of the series, will visit Everglades National Park, the Grand Canyon, Death Valley, Glacier National Park and Hawai'i Volcanoes National Park.Even though all these places seem to be well-known and explored, each of them hides its own secrets.A journey in the footsteps of wild America will go far beyond guidebooks.Areas will be explored where humans are still guests and must absolutely obey the rules of nature.

programme.title: Trials of the Wild

programme.title: Wildes Südafrika - Der 8. Kontinent
programme.desc: South Africa, like the entire continent, is very diverse.This is a place where cold-loving penguins live alongside ostriches that live in sandy areas.Sea snails and lively chameleons also thrive in this climate.South Africa has distinctive geographical features as well as extreme climatic conditions.Wild animals are exposed to constant changes in living conditions.On the west coast you can meet predatory sea lions that specialize in hunting young Cape boobies;in the south, giant crocodiles, lions and deer, and inland - elephants.

programme.title: The Flood 1: First Pulse
programme.desc: The Okavango Delta is a water phenomenon on the sands of the Kalahari Desert.Every year, heavy rains transform the barren region into a true oasis teeming with life.In a two-part documentary, director Brad Bestelink introduced the inhabitants of this unique place on Earth.The camera lens included both small dragonflies and giant elephants.Spectacular photos were taken from various perspectives - from the ground, from a bird's eye view and from the water depths.Scenes of exciting hunting intertwine with the idyll of life in a fertile land.Masters of survival The story begins while waiting for rain.On a sun-baked, dry and barren land, there is a fight for survival.Wild cats - a cheetah and a leopard - show off their skills.She stands out for her speed, he is able to lure his prey into an ambush.They both turn out to be effective in hunting, for example, impala.As the rain pours down, the region undergoes an almost magical transformation.The water attracts herds of various animals.Among them are African buffalos, which are hunted by lions.Viewers will also learn about the adventures of a longclaw who tries alone to ensure the safety of three chicks.Scenes from the lives of various species form a story about a complex ecosystem.

programme.title: One Strange Rock
programme.desc: A story about the creation and history of the planet, the laws governing it, its shape, the richness of flora and fauna, threats to the natural environment, natural wonders and surprising relationships.Actor Will Smith and people who have had the opportunity to spend time in space will talk about this extraordinary place in the universe.Accounts from astronauts including Mae Jemison, Mike Massimino, Leland Melvin and Chris Austin Hadfield will provide a completely new perspective on Earth.Director Darren Aronofsky and his film crew visited 45 countries and six continents.The photos were taken in, among others, the Arctic, the Himalayas, India and during the annual festival in Tarragona, Spain.Materials recorded on board the International Space Station were also used.In the following episodes, viewers will learn how oxygen is produced, the protective layers of the Blue Planet and the entire sequence of events that led to the creation of life.The topic of death, colonization, destruction, the search for alien forms and human intellect will also be discussed Life on Earth exists thanks to the atmosphere, which appears to people in space as a thin blue layer.An extraordinary chain of relationships leads to the production of oxygen, the most abundant element on the planet.Disrupting the delicate balance can leave living creatures unable to breathe.The creators of the series will talk about surprising phenomena - a sandstorm covering almost the entire world, the Amazon and its sky rivers, the power hidden by glaciers and single-celled algae - diatoms.

programme.title: America's National Parks
programme.desc: The creators of the series discover the majesty of the most interesting national parks located in the USA.They attract millions of tourists from all over the world.You can admire breathtaking landscapes from popular viewpoints.Viewers will see the beauty of eight national parks from a less obvious perspective.They will move not only to the famous Grand Canyon, but also to less familiar places.They will learn about the guards' favorite places and what makes each of these protected areas so special.They will also see what animals live in these places and what their life is like in the bosom of nature.The latest technologies were used to produce the series, including:drones and cameras with telephoto lenses.
